age.evidence: Male Wistar rats (6 weeks old, weight 220-330 g) ... acclimatized for 1 week before the experiment procedure started

sex.evidence: Male Wistar rats (6 weeks old, weight 220-330 g)

dosing.doses_raw: DOI (200 µg/kg, i.v.) on day 14 and DOI (1 mg/kg, i.p.) on day 15
dosing.evidence: rats were given intravenous (i.v.) injection of DOI (200 µg/kg) as a primary treatment on day 14 and intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of DOI (1 mg/kg in phosphate-buffered saline, PBS) as the secondary treatment on day15

group_housing.evidence: housed in the specific pathogen-free room at the Laboratory Animal Center (cage density not specified)

day_night_flipped.evidence: a 12 h light/dark cycle (direction not specified)

assays.assay_description: 35-min video recording in a clear cage immediately after DOI injection; manual scoring of back muscle contraction (BMC), wet dog shake (WDS), and stereotyped behaviors (grooming/self-gnawing), summed as total tic-like behaviors. Tested with PS128 (low/medium/high doses), haloperidol, and saline controls.

application_type.evidence: rats were given intravenous (i.v.) injection of DOI (200 µg/kg) ... on day 14 and intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of DOI (1 mg/kg) ... on day15

setup_habituation.evidence: rats were individually transferred to another clear cage for video recording immediately (no prior habituation described)

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were individually transferred to another clear cage for video recording immediately

food_restriction.evidence: rats were individually transferred to another clear cage for video recording; food not present in recording cage

water_restriction.evidence: rats were individually transferred to another clear cage for video recording; water not present in recording cage

time_to_assay.evidence: After the i.p. injection, rats were individually transferred to another clear cage for video recording immediately

outcomes.summary: Two-day DOI administration significantly increased back muscle contractions, wet dog shakes, and total tic-like behaviors. Oral PS128 (10^9 and 10^10 CFU/day) significantly reduced DOI-induced BMC and total tic-like behaviors (effect was threshold-dependent, not strictly dose-dependent); WDS was not significantly reduced. Haloperidol also reduced tic-like behaviors.
outcomes.statistics: BMC: F(4,44)=42.5, p<0.001; WDS: F(4,45)=6.63, p<0.05; total tic-like behaviors: F(4,51)=22.4, p<0.01; dose-response total tics: F(5,63)=13.2, p<0.01
outcomes.evidence: Oral gavage of PS128 (10^10 CFU, daily) alleviated the DOI-induced BMC (F(4,44)=42.5, p<0.01), total tic-like behaviors (F(4,51)=22.4, p<0.01) ... but not on WDS

B1_num_measures.evidence: counted the numbers of back muscle contraction (BMC), wet dog shake (WDS) and stereotyped behaviors ... total tic-like behaviors as the sum

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: From the 35-min recording period we counted the numbers (totals only)

B4_ethological.evidence: Perseverative head or body grooming or self-gnawing were counted as stereotyped behaviors

B5_social.evidence: rats were individually transferred to another clear cage

B7_automated_classification.evidence: recording video file names were converted into random number-code and were analyzed by at least two different counters

assays.assay_description: Acoustic startle reflex and PPI measured in Med Associates Startle Reflex System with rat restrained in acrylic animal holder. 5 min acclimatization, then 32 trials (24 prepulse+startle at 75/80/85 dB, 8 startle-alone at 120 dB), 1 min ITI. Tested 5 min after DOI/PBS i.p. on day 15.

application_type.evidence: i.v. DOI on day 14 and i.p. DOI on day 15; PPI tested 5 min after i.p. injection

setup_habituation.evidence: We give the rats three training sessions before the oral administration of PS128, saline, or haloperidol

setup_restrain.evidence: Rat was fixed in an acrylic animal holder on a calibrated platform in a soundproof chamber

time_to_assay.evidence: on day 15, 5 min after the i.p. injection of PBS or DOI we give the rats three more startle sessions

outcomes.summary: DOI reduced PPI percentage indicating sensorimotor gating deficit. Oral PS128 (10^9 and 10^10 CFU/day) and haloperidol significantly restored PPI percentage toward control levels.
outcomes.statistics: F(4,32)=13.3, p<0.001 (DOI vs saline); PS128 high dose vs DOI: p<0.05; dose-response: F(5,31)=7.98, p<0.05
outcomes.evidence: Oral gavage of PS128 (10^10 CFU, daily) alleviated ... the reduction on percentage of PPI (F(4,32)=13.3, p<0.05)

B1_num_measures.evidence: startle amplitude (S1, S2) and PPI percentage at three prepulse intensities

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Averaged across trials; no within-session time-course reported

B4_ethological.evidence: PPI startle magnitude is not an ethological behaviour

B5_social.evidence: Rat tested alone in startle chamber

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Med Associates Startle Reflex System - position/transducer-based

E1_environment_type.evidence: Med Associates Startle Reflex System / soundproof chamber

E7_social_context.evidence: Rat fixed in acrylic holder alone

D2_session_duration.evidence: 5 min acclimatization + 32 trials at 1 min ITI ≈ 37 min total

D3_recording_days.evidence: PPI data collected on day 15; pre-administration sessions described as 'training sessions'

D4_baseline.evidence: Pre-administration sessions were training sessions, not reported as analyzed baseline data

judge_notes: Two assays retained: tic-like behavior observation and PPI. Both are behavioural; merged candidates' identical assay structures.

B4 (ethological) on tic-like assay: scored 1 because perseverative grooming and self-gnawing (natural rodent behaviours) were explicitly counted as part of stereotyped behaviors, in addition to HTR/WDS. Candidates split (qwen/gpt-oss=0, glm=0); overrode based on explicit text mentioning grooming/self-gnawing.
PPI D2 session duration: 5 min acclimatization + 32 trials with 1 min ITI is explicitly stated, giving ~37 min — scored 1 (15-60 min). gpt-oss scored 0/low; this is supported by explicit ITI text.
Age scored as young_adult (6 weeks + 1 week acclimation = ~7 weeks at experiment start); range 42-49 days.
Vehicle for DOI: PBS explicitly stated for i.p. dose; gpt-oss said saline — corrected to PBS based on paper text.
Housing items kept as not_reported per rubric since paper does not explicitly state handling, cage density, light cycle direction, or enrichment status.
